findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key that protects the audit bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled (the default). Long-lived keys increase the blast radius of key material compromise, and CIS AWS Foundations 3.8 requires rotation to be enabled for customer-created CMKs.
